abstract: The main findings of the comparison are as follows. Overall, Alvenor improves blood pressure control compared with Standard care. Overall, Alvenor reduces side effects compared with Standard care. Overall, Cardivel improves blood pressure control compared with Standard care. Overall, Cardivel and Standard care reach about the same side effects.
conclusion: In the end, the evidence on each measure reads like this. Overall, Alvenor improves blood pressure control compared with Standard care. Overall, Alvenor reduces side effects compared with Standard care. Overall, Cardivel improves blood pressure control compared with Standard care. Overall, Cardivel and Standard care reach about the same side effects.
section:
### A further comparison between arms

Standard care is the usual blood pressure treatment given to every patient. Alvenor is a once daily tablet that relaxes the walls of the blood vessels. Cardivel is a tablet that slows the heart so it pushes with less force. This comparison was run at the Riverside Pressure Registry.

Table 7. The measure for each arm, shown subset by subset.

| Subset | Arm | Measure | Count | Total |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Younger adults, Reduced kidney function, University hospital | Standard care | Blood pressure control | 324 | 750 |
| Younger adults, Reduced kidney function, University hospital | Alvenor | Blood pressure control | 430 | 750 |
| Younger adults, Reduced kidney function, University hospital | Cardivel | Blood pressure control | 402 | 750 |

These values are listed for every arm and every subset.
